kind: gen_input (Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x input decks; two doped-supercell chains, six labels: relax -> scf -> bands per configuration)
provenance: Rubric constants and structure references come from our own reproduction of the two doped MnTe supercell chains: the as-run relax decks and the filled scf/bands decks under the leaf's run record. The unrelaxed doped builds under reference/ are regenerated deterministically from the relaxed primitive host cell plus the two dopant-site pairs (see notes.md, 'Structure staging'); the relaxed geometries under reference/ are extracted from the filled scf decks. The paper's reported values serve only as a fidelity check; the graded ground truth is our reproduction.

kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

structure_match.note: The deck's ATOMIC_SPECIES labels are mapped through UPF element identity to plain elements before structure construction and matching. Fallback = rigid-translation, species-aware; the AFM sublattice split is graded separately, so no lattice-symmetry op can absorb a wrong dopant placement. Relax decks match the UNRELAXED doped build within 0.1 A; scf/bands decks match our RELAXED geometry within 0.35 A, which also accepts an agent that submits the unrelaxed build to scf/bands (our ionic relaxations moved sites at most ~0.28 A).

required_summary.note: Each check is on the EFFECTIVE value (the tag if set, else the QE default in graderlib/grader_qe_inputs.py QE_DEFAULTS). Only the settings below are graded; the per-tag triage is in notes.md. Identity/count/Hubbard/AFM checks key on the UPF element, never on the agent's species-label strings.
required_summary.all_six: nspin = 2; AFM-A on at least two Mn species (producer seeds for relax/scf; bands inherit the supplied SCF model); Hubbard U in [2.7,3.3] eV on the exact 3d manifold of every Mn species and no other species (HUBBARD card any projector, or legacy lda_plus_u); UPF identity by element for every species label; element counts 16 Mn + 14 Te + 2 dopant; ecutwfc >= 50 Ry; ecutrho >= 4 x ecutwfc; occupations 'smearing' with 0 < degauss <= 0.05 Ry (metallic doped cell)
required_summary.relax: calculation 'relax' (fixed cell: the lattice is pinned by the doping convention; 'vc-relax' fails); K_POINTS automatic or equivalent complete equal-weight uniform crystal/tpiba mesh vs [5,5,3] per-axis floor, shift ungraded; structure matches the unrelaxed doped build within 0.1 A; conv_thr <= 1e-6 Ry
required_summary.scf: calculation 'scf'; K_POINTS automatic or equivalent complete equal-weight uniform crystal/tpiba mesh vs [8,8,5] per-axis floor, unshifted; structure matches the relaxed geometry within 0.35 A; conv_thr <= 1e-6 Ry
required_summary.bands: calculation 'bands'; nbnd >= 180 on the effective value (pw.x default computed from the catalog valences when omitted); K_POINTS explicit list (crystal/crystal_b/tpiba/tpiba_b) tracing the folded L-Gamma-L' line: every point on a folded-L leg, Gamma present, two folded-L legs of differing splitting-sign parity each reaching the supercell zone boundary (reach = max min(s,1-s) >= 0.4); no independent total-point floor; structure matches the relaxed geometry within 0.35 A

cross_deck.note: Within each supplied SCF-to-bands pair, effective prefix is the same logical dataset identifier. Ordered species/type and physical spin-model compatibility are checked separately. Output directories, working-directory placement and runtime-file existence are not scored. Relaxation feeds geometry and is not a saved-data pair; prefixes across different pairs are unconstrained.

score: 1 only if all six runs pass every REQUIRED check, the six structure extractions match their per-stage reference, and both per-config scf->bands chains are consistent (binary all-primary-pass; any single failure scores 0).

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.

runtime_directory_policy: Output directories, working-directory placement and directory equivalence are not scored. Required submitted files and logical file identities remain part of the input task. User decision 2026-09-17.

saved_afm_handoff.rule: AFM starting seeds remain required on relaxation and SCF producers. Collinear bands inherit the supplied SCF spin density: do not score repeated bands starting_magnetization. Require nspin=2, compatible ordered species labels/type indices and UPF identities; test consumer basal-plane encoding with producer seeds. Existing Hubbard, species counts and structure rules remain. No runtime files or directory settings are scored.
saved_afm_handoff.source: QE 7.5 PW/src/input.f90, potinit.f90 and io_rho_xml.f90; documented source trace in docs/review/grader_semantics_20260917/physics/followup.md. This is the submitted collinear SCF->bands route, not a general noncollinear waiver.

band_path_count_policy: Keep Gamma, two nondegenerate inequivalent arms, no off-line samples and existing folded boundary reach/parity checks. Remove the unsupported aggregate40 count; no replacement magic number. Endpoint-only full primitive folded images collapse to Gamma and cannot meet the two-arm reach tests.
conv_thr_scope: SCF and relax only; bands conv_thr is not graded.
